verdict: Leads are up sharply, but attribution gaps and setup milestones need resolution.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 10 leads at a cost of $234.30 per lead — a strong week-over-week improvement driven by Meta's 433 clicks converting at a better rate alongside your top Google campaign. That said, the lead volume is still thin enough that efficiency gains aren't yet confirmed as a stable trend. Five setup milestones originally scheduled for late July and early August remain unconfirmed complete, which is limiting full attribution visibility; those items are being actively closed out now. Your Google Business Profile activity has also gone quiet over the last three days, and that is being looked into this week. Expect clearer conversion data and a more complete picture as the outstanding setup work is finalized.
